skill.name: routemux-images
skill.description: Generate and edit images through the RouteMux AI gateway using a RouteMux API key, and save the result to a file. Use when the user asks to draw, generate, create, render or edit an image or picture, asks for an illustration/icon/logo/mockup/wallpaper, says 画图/画一张/生成图片/出图/改图, or when a coding agent's built-in image tool is unavailable because it is pointed at a custom API base URL. Requires the ROUTEMUX_API_KEY environment variable.
skill.summary: Generate or edit images through RouteMux and save each result to a user-selected path.
skill.author: rootfily-ai

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally uses curl, RouteMux network endpoints, a dedicated API key, and user-selected files. Most backtick alerts are Markdown false positives, but unsafe shell interpolation and plaintext shell-profile storage create credible risks.

remediation.issue: The setup instructions recommend storing the API key in a shell profile.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend a secure credential manager or session-only environment variable, and warn users before any persistent plaintext storage.

remediation.issue: Shell examples place prompt and path placeholders directly into command text.
remediation.suggestion: Pass values through argument arrays and generate request bodies with a structured JSON encoder.

remediation.issue: The workflow downloads a response URL without validation guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS, restrict expected hosts, limit response size, and verify image content before saving.

content.user_title: Generate and Edit Images with RouteMux
content.value_statement: Coding agents can lose built-in image tools when routed through a custom API gateway. This skill uses RouteMux endpoints to generate or edit images.
actual_capabilities: Queries the live RouteMux catalogue for image-generation models.
Generates one image per RouteMux API request.
Uploads an existing image for prompt-based editing.
Handles base64 image data or downloadable response URLs.
Saves results to a user-selected artifact path.
Reports the responding model, errors, and request identifiers.
limitations: Requires a valid ROUTEMUX_API_KEY and sufficient account credit.
Depends on RouteMux and upstream model availability.
Requests an aspect ratio but cannot guarantee exact pixel dimensions.
Creates one image per request and may use a backup model.

use_cases.title: Create Product Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate a focused product mockup and save it inside the active project.

use_cases.title: Produce Application Assets
use_cases.description: Create icons, illustrations, or backgrounds when built-in image tools are unavailable.

use_cases.title: Revise Existing Artwork
use_cases.description: Upload an image and request a targeted visual change through RouteMux.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image of [subject] in [style]. Save it as [output path].
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a basic image from a short description.

prompt_templates.title: Set Composition and Ratio
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [subject] with [composition], [lighting], and [color palette]. Use a [aspect ratio] format and save it to [output path].
prompt_templates.scenario: Control the main visual direction and output shape.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an Existing Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit [input image path] to [requested change]. Preserve [elements to keep] and save the result as [output path].
prompt_templates.scenario: Apply a defined change while retaining important source details.

prompt_templates.title: Choose and Verify a Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Query current RouteMux image models, select one suitable for [requirements], create [image brief], verify the returned dimensions, and report the responding model.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use live model selection and verify the delivered artifact.

output_examples.input: Create a square app icon showing a white compass on a green field.
output_examples.output: Saved the generated icon to the requested project path. The response used the selected RouteMux image model.

output_examples.input: Edit the supplied office photo so the wall is light gray while preserving the furniture.
output_examples.output: Saved the edited photo to the requested path and reported the model that completed the edit.

output_examples.input: Generate a wide editorial illustration and verify its dimensions.
output: Saved one generated illustration to the requested path.
Reported the requested aspect ratio, actual file dimensions, and responding model.

best_practices: Provide a precise subject, composition, style, and aspect ratio.
Choose an output path inside the active working directory.
Review the reported model and actual dimensions before using the asset.
anti_patterns: Do not place real API keys in prompts, files, logs, or replies.
Do not request many variants in one call to reduce network usage.
Do not assume a model slug or exact pixel size remains stable.

faq.question: What credential does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires ROUTEMUX_API_KEY in the environment and should not search other credential stores.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. It uploads one input image with a text instruction to the RouteMux editing endpoint.

faq.question: How does it choose an image model?
faq.answer: It queries the live RouteMux catalogue and selects a model that supports image generation.

faq.question: Can it guarantee exact dimensions?
faq.answer: No. The requested size reliably guides aspect ratio, but upstream models may return different pixel dimensions.

faq.question: Where does it save generated images?
faq.answer: It saves each image to the user-selected artifact path, normally inside the active working directory.

faq.question: What happens when RouteMux returns an error?
faq.answer: It interprets documented errors, limits retries for temporary failures, and reports the request identifier when available.
